analyst_view.overall: Early view: Trabzonspor host Corum six days after visiting Goztepe, with Conference League football still going. Thomas Reis has won every league game since taking over and Trabzonspor have conceded only eight all season; Corum under Burak Yilmaz score and concede freely (21-21) and lost 5-0 at home to Fenerbahce in their last game before the break.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.8 goals and I lean lower. Corum's open games push the number up, but Trabzonspor have conceded eight in eleven, so Corum's expected 1.3 looks high and a two- or three-goal home win is more likely than a shootout.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. Trabzonspor should have most of the ball at home while Corum counter, so the split looks right and I keep the total.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. Nothing reported points to a heated game, so I stay with the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.1 shots. Trabzonspor at home create plenty and Corum like to attack, so the volume seems fair even if many of Corum's efforts are likely to be low-quality.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target. Against the league's best defence I expect Corum to manage fewer than their 4.4, so slightly lower overall.
